scope: Custom full-window Sparkling host on one iOS 27.0 simulator. Package source code unchanged. Host contract changed; not a guarantee for unmodified Sparkling or physical devices.

firstVisibleFrame.scope: First discernible newly launched content and recorded tail only; no unseen-frame or physical presentation guarantee.

persistence.finalObservationSource: Parent QA owner reports snapshot-i tool transcript before running final Secure Store checks showed persistence: stored marker found after three cold launches.
persistence.scope: Existing baseline marker survived upgrade and final cold launches. No standalone final snapshot file; no new a11a4dd write followed by relaunch capture.

crypto.limitation: Native API smoke, not entropy measurement.

keyboard.scope: Opt-in native host input; simulator only.

rotation.scope: Settled reported inset values and portrait restoration only; no transient-frame or full visual geometry guarantee.
limitations: Landscape event history includes intermediate g4 t0/b0 before g5.
Landscape snapshot reports AX/windowed-capture fallback and clipped geometry; warnings preserved in snapshot.

sourceOnlyChecks: host-source-checks.json retains the earlier source-review stage and its then-pending runtime checklist; runtime outcomes are recorded here. InHouse Debug URL recovery remains outside this Release QA.
privateOriginals: Exact original evidence, historical checksums and all six videos retained in private ios-simulator-qa-originals archive. Public files have their own checksums in public-manifest.json. App-manifest.json describes hashes of private build artifacts, not public evidence hashes.

privacy.images: Twelve selected app-content frames only; no Springboard or contact sheets.
